provenance.applicabilityNote: Not version-gated at runtime. CombatFight exposes no client-build key, and gameVersion/logVersion are Warcraft Logs parser keys, not the World of Warcraft client build — comparing either against 12.1.0.69587 would be a gate that always passes while appearing rigorous. The build is recorded for traceability; a client build moving is a regeneration trigger for a human, not a runtime condition.

binding.sourceNote: create_action dispatches "death_strike" to death_strike_t, whose base is death_knight_melee_attack_t( "death_strike", p, p->talent.death_strike ) at sc_death_knight.cpp:10017-10020; talent.death_strike = find_talent_spell( talent_tree::CLASS, "Death Strike" ) at :14843, whose trait row carries spell 49998. Background when the talent is not taken (action.cpp:541-549).

create_action dispatches "heart_strike" to heart_strike_t( name, this, options_str ), whose base is heart_strike_base_t( n, p, p->talent.blood.heart_strike ) at sc_death_knight.cpp:11325-11328; talent.blood.heart_strike = find_talent_spell( SPECIALIZATION, "Heart Strike" ) at :14898, trait row spell 206930. Under the San'layn Vampiric Strike talent the constructor builds a vampiric_strike_blood_t child on spell.vampiric_strike (433895, :11288-11291, :15372) and execute() runs THAT child whenever buffs.vampiric_strike is up (:11350-11357), so an observed Vampiric Strike cast is this token executing.

create_action dispatches "blood_boil" to blood_boil_t, whose base is death_knight_spell_t( "blood_boil", p, p->talent.blood.blood_boil ) at sc_death_knight.cpp:9029-9032; talent.blood.blood_boil = find_talent_spell( SPECIALIZATION, "Blood Boil" ) at :14901, trait row spell 50842. The constructor sets cooldown->hasted = true (:9037): its charge cooldown is haste-scaled.

create_action dispatches "marrowrend" to marrowrend_t, whose base is death_knight_melee_attack_t( "marrowrend", p, p->talent.blood.marrowrend ) at sc_death_knight.cpp:11662-11667; talent.blood.marrowrend = find_talent_spell( SPECIALIZATION, "Marrowrend" ) at :14900, trait row spell 195182.

create_action dispatches "death_and_decay" to death_and_decay_t, whose base is death_and_decay_base_t( p, "death_and_decay", p->spec.death_and_decay ) at sc_death_knight.cpp:9722-9725; spec.death_and_decay = find_spell( 43265 ) at :14810 — an unconditional lookup, never not_found().

create_action maps the "any_dnd" (and "dnd_any") token to create_action( "death_and_decay", options_str ) unconditionally at sc_death_knight.cpp:14424-14427 (the comment mentions Defile; the code does not branch on it). The token is therefore the SAME action as death_and_decay, spell 43265, and an observed 43265 cast is either token's execution.

auto_attack_t's constructor (struct opens at sc_death_knight.cpp:7728) is built on the spell-less death_knight_melee_attack_t( "auto_attack", p ) base (:6387, default spell_data_t::nil()) and assigns trigger_gcd = 0_ms at :7753. execute() schedules the main-hand (and off-hand) swing (:7756-7763); ready() is `!is_moving() && main_hand_attack->execute_event == nullptr` (:7765-7771).

use_items_t's constructor (struct opens at player.cpp:10216) assigns trigger_gcd = timespan_t::zero(). OUTSIDE the Blood rotational decision domain (item use).
